text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
I never anticipated that it would be this fearsome a foe.
But we can't stand down. We need to win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなにも危険な存在だったなんて……
ですが、
負けるわけにはいきません！

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
We're all on the same page here!
That thing bullied Pukichi,
and for that it's gonna pay! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉ちゃんは一人じゃないよ！
ぷうきちにひどいことしたあいつには、
私がお仕置きしちゃうよ♪

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
I'm really, really scared... But I'll still fight!
Stealing away people's memories just isn't right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当は怖いけど……
私も戦います……！
大切な想い出を奪うなんて、
絶対にしちゃいけないことだから……！

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your support means the world to me.
Foggy! Prepare yourself!
I won't let you do what you want with my memories any longer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも……
ありがとうございます！
記憶の大精霊フォギー！
必ずあなたを倒し、
記憶を取り戻します！
